relevance_rank_note: Weak test of H2: the only receptor-trafficking data (Fig 6) compare exogenous APOE4 with no APOE and with APOE2 (never APOE3) in WT mouse primary neurons, and APOE4 INCREASED surface LRP1, opposite in direction to impaired recycling; no recycling rate, endosomal retention or ARF6 readout.

description: Surface proteins were isolated (Pierce cell-surface kit) from WT mouse primary neurons treated with APOE2, APOE4 or APOE2+APOE4; APOE4 increased surface LRP1 with no change in total LRP1, APOE2 had no effect and blocked the APOE4 increase. No APOE3 arm: the contrast is APOE4 vs untreated control and vs APOE2, not APOE4 vs APOE3. Direction (more surface receptor) runs against an APOE4 recycling impairment.
quote: We found that the addition of APOE2 had no effect on either the total or surface LRP1 levels (Fig. 6A–C). In contrast, APOE4 enhanced the trafficking of surface LRP1 levels (Fig. 6A–C). Interestingly, APOE4-mediated surface trafficking of LRP1 was blocked by APOE2 (Fig. 6A–C).
summary: (no APOE or APOE2 -> APOE4) -> (more surface LRP1, total LRP1 unchanged)
system: Primary cortical neurons from WT mouse P1 pups (in vitro; culture day for this assay not stated in main text), treated with exogenous human APOE2 and/or APOE4 protein (dose, lipidation state and duration not stated in main text; in SI Appendix); cell-surface protein isolation (Pierce kit, 3 wells pooled per condition) and Western blot for surface and total LRP1. In vitro; no APOE3 comparator (APOE4 vs vehicle and vs APOE2 only).
human_check: Fig 6 image viewed (PMC CDN pnas.2108870119fig06.jpg); confirmed no APOE3 arm. 6C: '**' bracket joins APOE4 to the control+APOE2 group; surface/total LRP1 ~10000 (APOE4) vs ~2500 (control), i.e. ~4x control, not vs APOE3 (no APOE3 arm). Star key from the legend. Confirm in SI Appendix the APOE protein source, lipidation, dose and treatment time. Class 5 because no APOE3 arm; would be class 1 if APOE3 were present.

description: In WT mouse primary neurons treated with APOE4, the exocytosis inhibitor Exo-1 significantly reduced the APOE4-induced increase in surface LRP1, indicating the APOE4 effect depends on exocytic delivery to the surface. No APOE3 arm; mechanistic follow-up of the APOE4-increases-surface-LRP1 result.
quote: To validate the APOE4-mediated surface trafficking of LRP1, we treated the neurons with an exocytic pathway blocker, Exo-1. As expected, inhibition of exocytosis significantly reduced APOE4-mediated surface trafficking of LRP1 receptors (Fig. 6D–F).
summary: (APOE4 -> APOE4 + Exo-1 exocytosis block) -> (less surface LRP1)
system: Primary cortical neurons from WT mouse P1 pups (in vitro), treated with exogenous human APOE4 protein with or without Exo-1 (dose/time not stated in main text); cell-surface protein isolation (Pierce kit) and Western blot for surface/total LRP1. In vitro; no APOE3 comparator; the varied factor is a drug.
human_check: Fig 6 image viewed (PMC CDN pnas.2108870119fig06.jpg); confirmed no APOE3 arm. 6F: '***' bracket APOE4 vs APOE4+Exo-1; ~28000 vs ~19500, ~30% lower with Exo-1. Star key from the legend. Exo-1 blocks ER-Golgi/exocytic traffic broadly, so this does not separate recycling from biosynthetic delivery.

description: WT mouse primary neurons were treated with astrocyte-conditioned medium (ACM) plus APOE4, or ACM from GPC-4 shRNA-treated astrocytes plus APOE4; without GPC-4, APOE4 produced significantly less surface LRP1, suggesting the APOE4 surface increase depends on astrocyte-secreted GPC-4. No APOE3 arm.
quote: In the absence of GPC-4, APOE4 addition resulted in a significant reduction in surface trafficking of LRP1 (Fig. 6K–M).
summary: (APOE4 + ACM -> APOE4 + GPC-4-depleted ACM) -> (less surface LRP1)
system: Primary cortical neurons from WT mouse P1 pups (in vitro) treated with ACM from WT mouse astrocyte culture alone, ACM + exogenous human APOE4, or GPC-4 shRNA-treated ACM + APOE4; cell-surface protein isolation (Pierce kit) and Western blot for surface/total LRP1. Mouse neurons and mouse astrocyte medium; in vitro; no APOE3 comparator; the varied factor is GPC-4 in the medium.
human_check: Fig 6 image viewed (PMC CDN pnas.2108870119fig06.jpg); confirmed no APOE3 arm. 6M: '***' bracket APOE4 vs APOE4+GPC-4 shRNA; ~18800 vs ~12000, ~36% lower; APOE4 vs control is '****'. Star key from the legend. Legend cites '(J)' for the GPC-4 shRNA surface reduction; the image confirms M is the GPC-4 shRNA panel (J is GPC-4 alone, no APOE4).
